title: An item: treasure, a consumable or junk (R8.4)

category.description: Junk is the catch-all for everything that isn't treasure or a consumable (D65).

slot.description: The equipment slot it goes in, if it can be equipped (R8.2, D83). Most items with effects are trinkets.

bait.description: A bait's kind, from rules/fish-preferences.json: the fish that prefer it are likelier (D101). Only for the bait slot.

bobber.description: A bobber's looks (D83): colours in place of the red feather and the tan float. Bobbers are cosmetic.

effects.description: Every item with an upside needs a downside too (R8.5).

event.description: An event that starts when this item is fished up; the event has trigger: item (R10.2, D84).

set.description: The set it's a piece of (content/sets/, 8.7).

page.description: Text the player can read in its tooltip: a page of a book, a letter (8.7).

fragmentOf.description: A piece of a hidden location's map (8.2): enough of them found opens it.

useful.description: Junk with a use (the Alchemist, a quest): never traded away as useless (trade: junk, 7.9).

devOnly.description: A test item, had only through the ?dev bench, so no location needs to list it (D83).
